hints.title: Required Survival Energy Obstacle
hints.text: The knight must have at least 1 health point at every step while navigating from top-left to bottom-right. How can working backward from the princess calculate the minimum initial health needed upon entering each room?

hints.title: Reverse Boundary Survival Invariant
hints.text: Upon entering room (r, c), the required health is at least 1 and must suffice to cover room entry before reaching the minimum required health of either (r + 1, c) or (r, c + 1).

hints.title: Bottom-Right Backward Propagation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a 1D array of width n + 1 filled with infinity, setting the element representing destination arrival to 1. Traverse rows from bottom to top and columns from right to left: for each cell, compute the minimum health needed to exit into either neighbor minus the cell value, bounded below by 1. Return the top-left value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single reverse pass across M x N grid updates a 1D buffer of length N + 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward search cannot anticipate future health deficits without state branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backward 1D array compression saves grid storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing that this problem must be solved backward from destination to origin.
